en: A screw is actually an inclined plane wrapped around a cylinder, which allows it to convert rotational force into strong linear forward motion.
The thin blades of ice skates melt a microscopic layer of ice into water, creating a slippery surface that drastically reduces friction.
Astronauts on the Moon can jump six times higher than on Earth because the Moon's gravitational pull is only one-sixth as strong.
Earth's geographic North Pole is actually a magnetic south pole, which is why the north-seeking tip of a compass needle is attracted to it.
A lemon can power a small digital clock because its acidic juice acts as an electrolyte, allowing electricity to flow between inserted metal nails.
Light travels so incredibly fast that it can circle the Earth's equator approximately seven and a half times in just one single second.
Sound travels about 15 times faster through solid steel than through air because the tightly packed metal molecules transmit vibrations much more quickly.
The lowest possible temperature in the universe is absolute zero at minus 273.15 degrees Celsius, where all atomic and molecular motion completely stops.
A roller coaster car at the very top of its highest hill holds maximum potential energy right before it transforms into kinetic energy.
Unlike most substances, liquid water uniquely expands and becomes less dense when it freezes into solid ice, which is why icebergs float.
An electric eel can generate a massive shock of up to 860 volts to paralyze prey using thousands of specialized electricity-producing cells in its body.
A glass prism separates white sunlight into a rainbow of colors because each specific color of light bends at a slightly different angle inside the glass.
